details.productName: A Multimodal LLM Powered Robotic Dog for Proactive Hazard Prevention
details.productDescription: This product, Multimodal LLM-Powered Robotic Dog for Proactive Hazard Prevention, is an AI-driven control system designed for robotic dogs and drones, enabling seamless intercommunication between them. The system allows a single robotic dog to operate autonomously, collecting real-time environmental data through its on-board 360-degree camera. This data is processed by an integrated AI edge computer, which performs real-time multimodal hazard detection, covering visual, spatial, and contextual analysis. Detected hazards include falls from height, falling objects, collisions with moving objects, entrapment, vehicle-related incidents, and electrocution. Upon identifying a hazard, the system instantly generates geotagged alerts and sends notifications to users via SMS or email.
